camera_units: native pixels; x right, y down
forward_model: DM0-M1 synthetic fixture only; independent fixed optical zeros; visual degree 2
gpu: not required for stage-one linear bootstrap
noise_policy: full native sample covariance of adjacent differences / sqrt(2); only timestamp-reliable reviewed intervals, complete adjacent rows and source frames; positive finite dt; no interval/gap bridging; real eye motion may contribute
pairing_policy: read stored pair_index; require reviewed [2,1,0]; never re-sort
validity_policy: finite and present P1 and all three mapped P4; no pupil, shape or residual gate
